# 7428 - Quadruple 2-input NOR buffer

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7428.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7428.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 9 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7428 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7428.png) | ![7428 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nor-buf2.png) | ![7428 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nor-buf2.png) |

A rectangle with an X running into all four corners; the rectangle's right edge is followed by a pointed end.

How to tell it on a drawing: X box + point = NOR buffer. Compare 7433, which adds a line down the centre of the box.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1Y = NOT(1A OR 1B) | 1Y is the NOR of 1A, 1B. |
| 4 | 2Y = NOT(2A OR 2B) | 2Y is the NOR of 2A, 2B. |
| 10 | 3Y = NOT(3A OR 3B) | 3Y is the NOR of 3A, 3B. |
| 13 | 4Y = NOT(4A OR 4B) | 4Y is the NOR of 4A, 4B. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 48 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -2.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Buffer: IOL 48 mA vs 16 mA for 7402 and IOH -2.4 mA vs -0.4 mA: can drive three times as many inputs or a long line. IOS -70 to -180 mA. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 6 | 9 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 12 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| any | Y | PLH | 10 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 ohm, CL 150 pF |
| any | Y | PHL | 12 | 18 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 ohm, CL 150 pF |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.
